scenes.title: 先听原创小故事
scenes.text: It is Saturday. Dad is cooking lunch. Mei sets the table. Her brother puts away the toys. Mei says, “We can help at home.” After lunch, they have time to play together.

scenes.text: 最后一句说他们午饭后有时间一起玩。我们可以据此讨论：一起分担事情，会给家庭带来什么？这是基于文本作理解，不是随意猜人物心情。
